protocol.origin: first control input time of each episode
protocol.interpolation: linear sensor values, then slip; no extrapolation
protocol.formula: mean of squared clipped longitudinal wheel ratios, core.py convention
protocol.phase_rule: Governor command windows; PI paired contact-relative windows, not PI actions
protocol.interval: first control input through final action end; postarrival 2s excluded as in native route metric
